name: com.unity.web.stripping-tool
description: A package for optimizing the code size of Unity Web builds.

samples.description: Example of how to instrument a build for submodule profiling via scripting.
Example of how to perform all aspects of submodule stripping for a build via scripting.

_upm.changelog:
### Added

- Added support for stripping and profiling Wasm64 (memory64) builds. Builds configured with memory above 4 GB are automatically detected and processed with the correct WebAssembly feature flags.

### Changed

- Improved System.Security submodule definition for more granular stripping in builds made with Unity >= 6.6.

### Fixed

- Fixed submodule profiling and submodule error handling for multithreaded builds made with Unity >= 6.5.
- Fixed "Run" and "Strip and Run" button not opening the browser in some newer versions of Unity.
